name: 申請状況と連絡操作を含む友だち一覧
prompt:
Create a clean, compact Japanese friend-list screen on the exact 390×476 px white canvas. The native preview controls the exact content, typography, positions, colors and spacing. Use the source crop to understand the friend request card, alphabetic friend grouping and source blue Add Friends text; use the preview for Japanese localization and the Lighthouse palette.

Reproduce the preview: centered title 友だち; top-right text action 友だちを追加; gray search field with magnifier and placeholder 友だちを検索; a friend-request card with green paper-plane icon, title 友だち申請, subtitle 受信0件・送信1件, and a right chevron; kana headings さ and た; and the two compact friend rows showing avatar initial 佐, bold name 佐藤 ゆう, pale mint affiliation chip 交流会, and separate phone/message icon buttons. Keep all exact Japanese text and the duplicate friend row exactly as the preview shows.

Color 友だちを追加 in clear link blue #1976D2 without underline. It corresponds to the source’s blue Add Friends text action. Keep the 友だち申請 title dark because it belongs to a navigation card, the search placeholder gray, member names dark, chips green/mint, and call/message icons green. Do not recolor other labels blue. Preserve the Japanese-initial avatar adaptation instead of source portraits, and do not copy source-only brand labels, heart badges, English wording, keyboard, or status bars. Do not add content or invent link destinations.
reviewNotes: v001 compared with the 390x476 preview. The top-right 友だちを追加 link-style action is blue #1976D2; the friend-request card, search field, names, affiliation chips and contact controls retain native colors. All key content is present, but typography and vertical spacing are too large, shifting the request row and friend rows down. Full raw output used; raw SHA-256 and comparison are in review-w02-a001.json.
